messages.content: Hi! How can I help you today?

Please reply with **the email address** used to place the order (or, if you prefer, your **first name + last name + zip code**).  

Once I’ve verified you, I’ll look up **#W8855135** (and confirm whether it’s the correct order/status) and then we can proceed with the **return** and your refund to the **original payment method**.
